data.narrative:
Andromeda Surgical is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Nick Damiano and Kartik Tiwari, having raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a broader Biotech & Health sector universe comprising 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method proved applicable. Using the $3.0B total-raised proxy as a reference base and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $7.5B. The peer-median method could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow filter (0 qualifying datapoints); a broad all-sector median would introduce excessive noise. Public-comp anchoring via the sector's 5.5x median P/S multiple (across RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) could not be executed because target revenue is not disclosed.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $6.4B to $8.6B, with a median of $7.5B. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single valuation pathway and the absence of revenue data. Until additional comparable-stage transactions or revenue information surfaces, this range should be treated as indicative rather than definitive. The analysis would benefit from disclosure of revenue or from identification of additional seed-stage biotech transactions.
